cohort: 37 women with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) positive for aquaporin-4-immunoglobulin-IgG
finding: Irregular menstruation was common in NMOSD patients (62%), and pregnancies were associated with obstetrical complications and an increased risk of postpartum relapses, particularly in the first three months after delivery.
mod_finding: This study found that pregnancies in women with NMOSD were associated with obstetrical complications and increased disease activity postpartum.
